title: llm-proxy model
description: One model (or variant) object of the llm-proxy config. Fields not set here are validated by the proxy itself; the editor lint below the form reports the same problems.

disabled.description: Advertise the modality to the client but reject requests that use it.

reasoning.description: Reasoning controls. disabled:true turns reasoning off; otherwise defaultEffort and effortsMapping are required.

disabled.description: When true, reasoning is disabled and defaultEffort/effortsMapping must be omitted.

effortsMapping.description: Maps a client-requested effort to the upstream effort value; null passes the client effort through.

model.description: A base model routed through one provider.

provider.description: Provider name from the providers list.

providerModelName.description: Model name sent to the provider.

clientModelName.description: Name clients use for this route; defaults to providerModelName.

displayName.description: Label shown in editors and pickers.

protocolAdapter.description: Bridges a client surface to the upstream protocol.

baseInstructions.description: System prompt sent with the request.

inputs.description: Input modalities; null or omitted means text and image.

noImage.description: Strip image parts before sending upstream.

adjustUsageForDSH.description: Adjust usage accounting for DSH clients.

effortMapping.description: Maps client effort values to upstream effort values.

variants.description: Variants of this model; each inherits every field it omits.

variant.description: A variant of a base model; omitted fields inherit from the base.

clientModelName.description: Name clients use for this route.

agentRunners.description: Agent runners that may use this variant; empty or omitted means all.

displayName.description: Label shown in editors and pickers.

protocolAdapter.description: Bridges a client surface to the upstream protocol.

baseInstructions.description: System prompt sent with the request.

inputs.description: Input modalities; null or omitted inherits the base inputs.

compat.description: Compatibility flags merged over the base flags.

reasoning.description: Omitted or null inherits the base reasoning.

noImage.description: Strip image parts before sending upstream.

adjustUsageForDSH.description: Adjust usage accounting for DSH clients.

effortMapping.description: Maps client effort values to upstream effort values.
